newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells Aug 4-8 fuel oil at around $100/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells Aug 4-8 fuel oil at around $100/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has sold by tender 30,000 tonnes of 3.0-percent sulphur, 180-centistoke fuel oil at around $100 per tonne, a company source said on Wednesday.
The cargo is for August 4-8 lifting on a free-on-board basis, the source said. The tender closed on July 15.
In its last tender, Taiwan sold two 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil cargoes for first half July lifting at around $100.50 per tonne.
